messages.content:
You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:prescription_error: Prescriptions and e-prescribing problems always go to a human. (also matched: urgent_clinician) Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
Having trouble processing medication substitution alerts

I am trying to handle an out-of-stock notification for a patient's script, but the system keeps locking up every time I attempt to select an alternative therapeutic agent from the dropdown menu. This is the third time this week a pharmacy alert workflow has failed on me, and it is holding up my afternoon schedule. Please look into why this substitution module is lagging and let me know how to push this prescription through immediately.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hi,

Thank you for reaching out and letting us know about the issue you’re experiencing with the medication substitution alerts. I’m sorry for the inconvenience this has caused you.

I’ve escalated this to a member of our support team who specializes in prescription and e‑prescribing workflows. They will investigate the problem and work on a resolution.

We’ll keep you updated as soon as we have more information.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
[Support Team]"
}
